what: Rubrik sells data security and backup software. It copies an organisation's data in a form attackers cannot alter, so that after a ransomware attack the business can be restored rather than ransomed.
customers: Large enterprises, government agencies and healthcare organisations protecting their data.
money: cloud and software subscriptions for data protection and recovery
moat: Immutable backups integrated across cloud, on-premises and software-as-a-service data, where a customer's recovery plan is built around its tooling and tested against it.
risks: It makes a significant operating loss because of large stock-based compensation
Competition in backup and data protection is intense
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: Revenue grew about 48% last year and about 30% a year over three years
Gross margin of 80% with cash of $1.7 billion against almost no debt
Ransomware recovery has become a board-level spending priority
watch: Subscription annual recurring revenue growth and progress toward profitability.
